verdict.rationale: Raygun supports some rule-based automation, e.g. 'Ignore by rule' conditions for errors (docs-11) and PagerDuty/Slack integrations that trigger incidents 'when an issue is triggered from this rule' (docs-17, docs-16), showing basic event-triggered actions. However there's no evidence of a general-purpose rule engine letting users define arbitrary custom conditions/actions across events (webhooks, custom workflows, multi-condition triggers) beyond these specific integrations. missing for 10: a documented general rules/automation engine, evidence of custom action definitions beyond alerting integrations, independent confirmation of rule reliability.
